question: Using only the data from the ‘results’ table, find the three years in which the sum of the highest total points earned by any driver and the highest total points earned by any constructor in that year (both calculated by summing up points from the ‘results’ table) is smallest, and list those three years in order of ascending total.
sql:
WITH driver_totals AS (
    SELECT r_result.year, r.driver_id, SUM(r.points) as driver_total_points
    FROM results r
    JOIN races r_result ON r.race_id = r_result.race_id
    GROUP BY r_result.year, r.driver_id
),
max_drivers AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(driver_total_points) as max_driver_points
    FROM driver_totals
    GROUP BY year
),
constructor_totals AS (
    SELECT r_result.year, r.constructor_id, SUM(r.points) as constructor_total_points
    FROM results r
    JOIN races r_result ON r.race_id = r_result.race_id
    GROUP BY r_result.year, r.constructor_id
),
max_constructors AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(constructor_total_points) as max_constructor_points
    FROM constructor_totals
    GROUP BY year
)
SELECT md.year, md.max_driver_points + mc.max_constructor_points as total_sum
FROM max_drivers md
JOIN max_constructors mc ON md.year = mc.year
ORDER BY total_sum
LIMIT 3

        SUM(r.points) as driver_total_points

constructor_points AS (

        SUM(r.points) as constructor_total_points
